items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: John introduced me and all and we talked just a little bit

ctx.x: How did you come to (inaudible)? She was with you (inaudible)?

Yeah. [I met her] (Inaudible) through John Hammond, you know, and she was singing at Monroe's Place uptown. That's where I first heard her. She was (inaudible) teens then. Really, (inaudible). John took her by and listened to her. She had really a strange way of delivering a song, you know? All so wonderful. (Inaudible) with the band.
